desc: The guided farm tutorial (state: Save.d.tutorial.ft = {did, done, skipped}). Five steps, one prompt at a time, with a Skip always on show (owner, Nov 8: shorter tutorials; skipping loses nothing: the house goes up, the starter food and the end gems are given). What the cut steps taught (stone, hammer, a job, the Market, Hob) is a one-time hint now (FirstTimeHint, content/rules/hints.json 'farm'). Every owner-confirmable choice is under 'options' so it is a one-line change.

options.house_cost_in: farm_build.json build.house (wood and stone, spent as it goes up, and swings of labour)

options_doc: tracker_replaces_day1: the top-right card is the Goals tracker. player_swing: holding the interact key near a site hammers (hold it: a hammer beat every HunterTool.TOOLS.hammer.period seconds), so one Boki is enough. end_gems: the one reward at the end (the old +5 each and +30); a skip gets it too. free_order: after the house is down feed and crop can come in either order (false: strictly in the listed order). skippable: shows a Skip button beside the hint line (owner, Nov 8: always).

hints.go: Hold {interact} at a tree to chop. The house takes {house_cost}.

hints.place: Press {build}, pick House and click the marked spot ({house_cost}).
Press {build} and set a trough down for your Boki.
hints.fill: Press {interact} at the trough to fill it.

hints.patch: Press {build} and place a crop patch by the water.
hints.patch_dry: Press {build} and place a crop patch.
hints.plant: Press {interact} at the patch to plant a seed.
hints.water: Press {interact} at the patch to water it.
hints.grow: Your seed is growing: ripe in {secs}s.
hints.pick: It's ripe! Press {interact} to pick it.

world.patch: Place the patch by the water

hints.go: Press {interact} at the portal to head out on your first expedition.

tracker.title: Goals
tracker.per_source_doc: At most this many rows from each source, so the top five are not all Hunter challenges. Order inside a source: closest to done first; ready-to-claim rows lead everything.

steps_doc: needs: steps that must be done first; needs_all: everything else; waits: hint stages that are only waiting (the next open step is shown meanwhile); spot: per hint stage, what FarmSpotlight lights up (hub: a bottom-bar button id, world: the step's marker in the world, a Boki). Each target gets its full dimmed beat once, then only a soft ring.
